title: Mine Eyes Have Seen the Glory

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Mine eyes have seen the glory of the coming of the Lord;
He is [Eb]trampling out the vintage where the [Bb]grapes of wrath are stored;
He hath loosed the fateful lightning of his terrible swift sword;

sections.name: Refrain
lines: Glory! Glory! Hallelujah! Glory! Glory! Hallelujah!
[Eb]Glory! Glory! Hallelujah! His [Bb]truth is marching on.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: He has sounded forth the trumpet that shall never call retreat;
[Eb]He is sifting out the hearts [Bb]of men before His judgment seat;
O be swift, my soul, to answer Him! be jubilant, my feet!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: In the beauty of the lilies Christ was born across the sea,
[Eb]With a glory in His [Bb]bosom that transfigures you and me;
As He died to make men holy, let us live to make men free!
